description: PM-9 Battle Simulator overlay. No fixture: from the real main menu it writes a small plan into user://ai_plans/, opens the simulator, and configures a 2-game A_C_test mirror on crucible_of_battle with the plan on player 1 and None on player 2. It runs the CANCEL path first — start, cancel, wait for the run to actually stop, and assert Close lands back on MainMenu (after a run the scene underneath the overlay is a finished battle, not the menu). Then it runs both games to completion and asserts two rows, a summary, an ETA driven by the MEASURED seconds per game rather than a guess, and — the check that matters — that every row and the summary line agree with the JSON the backend wrote to disk, so the table is a view of the results rather than a second copy of them. Finally the adherence column shows the plan/no-plan split: nonzero for the planned seat, exactly zero for the other.

steps.script:
var ui = tree.root.get_node("PlanSimulatorUI")
return ui.run_button.disabled and not ui.cancel_button.disabled

var ui = tree.root.get_node("PlanSimulatorUI")
return ui.summary_text().find("completed game(s)") >= 0

var ui = tree.root.get_node("PlanSimulatorUI")
return ui.replay_label.text.find("Watch Replays") >= 0
